LEGAL

Privacy Policy

What the MESA website and MESA accounts collect, why, how long it is kept and how you control it.

Last updated: 8 November 2026 · Version 2026-11-08 · The Turkish text prevails.

On this page

  1. In short
  2. Who is responsible
  3. What we process and why
  4. Your account
  5. Service providers and transfers abroad
  6. Security
  7. Children
  8. Your rights
  9. Related documents
  10. Changes

In short

  • Reading the site needs no account, and the site sets no cookies.
  • We collect personal data when you create an account, request research access or send the early access form.
  • We do not sell personal data and do not show ads.
  • Commercial emails are sent only if you opt in, and you can opt out at any time.

Who is responsible

What we process and why

MESA account

Data
Email address, account ID, password (stored only as a hash by Supabase Auth), sign-in time, and the name, email and avatar shared by Google or GitHub if you use them.
Purpose
Creating and running your account, signing you in, password reset.
Legal basis
Establishing and performing the contract (KVKK art. 5/2-c).
Retention
While the account is open; deleted within 30 days after you close it.

Agreement records

Data
Which version of the Terms and notices you accepted, when, and your commercial message choice.
Purpose
Proving what was agreed and when.
Legal basis
Legal obligation and establishing, exercising or defending a right (KVKK art. 5/2-ç, e).
Retention
While the account is open, and for 3 years after a commercial message consent ends.

Benchmark research access

Data
Your stated purpose, the request status and download activity linked to your account.
Purpose
Reviewing requests and giving access to the data packages.
Legal basis
Establishing and performing the contract (KVKK art. 5/2-c).
Retention
While the account is open.

Early access form

Data
Email, area of interest, use case; optionally organisation and public GitHub URL. A one-way hash of your network address for abuse protection.
Purpose
Reviewing your request and contacting you about it.
Legal basis
Your explicit consent given on the form (KVKK art. 5/1); for the address hash, legitimate interest (art. 5/2-f).
Retention
Until the request is handled; the address hash for at most 48 hours.

Commercial messages

Data
Email address and your opt-in, only if you chose it.
Purpose
Sending MESA news and product updates.
Legal basis
Your explicit consent (KVKK art. 5/1) and approval under Law No. 6563.
Retention
Until you withdraw it.

Security and visit statistics

Data
Technical request data (IP address, browser, time) in the logs of the hosting and network providers; aggregate page-view counts without cookies.
Purpose
Keeping the site secure and available; understanding which pages are read.
Legal basis
Legitimate interest (KVKK art. 5/2-f).
Retention
As set by the providers; we do not build visitor profiles.

Your account

Your session is kept in this browser tab only and ends when you close the tab or sign out. You can change your commercial email choice in your account settings at any time.

Service providers and transfers abroad

  • Supabase: account sign-in, database and file storage.
  • GitHub Pages and Cloudflare: hosting, network security and cookie-free visit statistics.
  • Google and GitHub: only if you choose to sign in with them.

These providers may store data on servers outside Turkey (for example in the EU or the USA). Transfers abroad are carried out under the conditions of KVKK art. 9.

Security

Connections are encrypted (HTTPS). Passwords are stored only as hashes. Database rules let each user read only their own records; administrators see requests only through an authenticated panel.

Children

MESA accounts are meant for people aged 18 or over.

Your rights

Under KVKK art. 11 (and, for people in the EU, GDPR art. 15–22) you can access, correct, delete and object. The KVKK Information Notice explains how to apply.

Related documents

  • KVKK Information Notice
  • Cookie Policy
  • Terms of Use
  • Commercial Electronic Message Consent

Changes

If this policy changes in a way that affects you, we will tell you on the site and, for account holders, by email.
